findings.text: The prose states that "a copy carrying a spare body that nothing calls is refused", but the source scan at bound_seeds.py:86 detects a local body only by the literal substring "sorted(", so a spare body written as list(waits).sort() is not refused; the claim is broader than the mechanism. The material regression (windows cut by a local body) is still caught by the co_names clause at bound_seeds.py:74 whatever the body text, and an uncalled spare body is harmless, so this does not hold the node.

The provenance guard is exercised only by the hand-run four-arm control; git grep finds no reference to bound_seeds in tests/ or imas_ambix/ and no CI job runs it, so removing the _estimator_problem call or weakening a clause leaves the check green and nothing reddens -- the guard on the guard remains a manual control.
